name: Boston Solar
old_description: Homeowners throughout New England are switching to solar energy, and you should, too. Rooftop solar panels have a long list of benefits that will save you money, reduce your impact on the environment, and reduce your reliance on your utility company.
about:
Boston Solar was founded in 2011 in Woburn, Massachusetts. The company began as a residential solar installer serving homeowners throughout New England.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy solutions, handling design, permitting, installation, and post-installation monitoring for both residential and commercial clients. Over 13 years, it has completed more than 7,500 installations and expanded into the commercial market, with projects for small businesses and notable venues such as Fenway Park. The company also offers battery backup systems for existing solar customers. Its 30-year system warranty covers workmanship and performance.

Boston Solar serves homeowners across New England and commercial customers including small businesses and large-scale facilities. Its residential clients seek energy independence and protection against rising utility costs, while commercial clients include iconic locations like Fenway Park, home of the Boston Red Sox.

The company emphasizes a fully integrated model, managing every step from initial consultation through activation and ongoing support. It highlights its experienced in-house team, transparent design process, and commitment to project timeliness as key differentiators.
